prompts.panel:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Production reusable game completion modal frame, portrait transparent PNG.
Input image 1 is the approved exact edit target. Preserve its charming hand-painted storybook style, physical irregular dark forest-green outer border, warm gold trim, cream textured paper, distinctive deep forest-green title plaque, pointing-at-viewer hand at top left, and small red flower with green leaves at bottom right.
Primary request: make a CLEAN EMPTY reusable version of this EXACT modal. Erase ALL lettering and numbers everywhere, erase the three red flowers in the central reward row, erase the thin decorative horizontal branch divider, and erase the entire large golden pill button at the bottom including its border and shadow. Fill ALL erased interior areas seamlessly with the same cream paper texture. Keep the dark green header plaque empty, ready for HTML title. Keep all perimeter decorations including the pointing hand and bottom-right corner flower.
Composition: same portrait aspect ratio and same outer silhouette. Keep the middle 55% height as empty cream paper with only the left and right thin vertical borders, enabling a variable-height UI to use top / stretchable-middle / bottom image slices. All UI content will be rendered with real HTML, so the image itself MUST CONTAIN ZERO TEXT, ZERO SYMBOLS, ZERO CENTRAL FLOWERS, ZERO BUTTONS and ZERO DIVIDERS.
Transparent background: actual alpha transparency outside the modal perimeter and behind projecting decorations, no checkerboard, no solid backdrop. Keep complete hand and complete corner flower uncut. Close framing, generous enough transparent edge margins to preserve the silhouette. Only erase specified interior content; do not redesign the approved frame, hand, title plaque, colors, paper texture or corner flower. No additional decoration.
prompts.button:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Reusable isolated hand-painted game primary CTA button, transparent PNG.
Input image 1 is the approved exact style and object reference. Extract/recreate ONLY the wide golden capsule button near the bottom of the reference, completely isolated from the surrounding modal and all other objects.
Primary request: one horizontal golden capsule button with NO TEXT, NO SYMBOL, NO ARROW. Preserve the approved button's warm honey-gold hand-painted parchment-like textured face, slim bright gold inner highlight border, thick dark chestnut-brown sculpted irregular outer rim, softly rounded capsule corners, tactile painterly brush detail and subtle lower shadow. No leaves or flowers on the button itself.
Composition: straight-on flat game UI asset, wide horizontal pill approximately 4.4:1 width to height, fills most of a wide canvas with small transparent margins. No perspective. Center it in the canvas.
Actual alpha transparent background, not a checkerboard picture, no colored backdrop. The only visible object is the entirely blank golden button. No text at all, no letters, no numbers, no pictograms, no arrows, no illustration, no modal frame. Match the exact reference gold/brown palette and hand-painted texture.
